body:
Triage: lands in `examples/app-showcase/src/automation/flows/index.ts` ⇒ routed `domain:services`. Graded `Bug` · `priority:p3`.

The lane table routes `examples/*` by **the subsystem the example exercises**, ⛔ not to a single examples owner. What is being decided here is flow containment semantics — loop bodies, `try_catch`, what a run summary reports when an iteration fails — and `packages/services/service-automation` is `domain:services`. The same lane holds #14456 (the contained-failure visibility contract) and #14955 (`$error` staleness on the throw arm), so the reader who takes this already has the model loaded.

`Bug` by the mechanical boundary test: nothing widens; a shipped example demonstrates the failure shape the platform now warns about.

`priority:p3` — the rule is warning-tier, nothing breaks, and the showcase is the reference app rather than the product.

### ⭐ The severity is understated by "it is only an example", and that is the reason to fix rather than annotate

The card names the real cost in one line: **the example apps are what AI authors copy from.** A loop that ends the whole run on the first task with an empty `owner`, while the summary reports `acted: 0` for work that did happen, is precisely the shape #13681 measured. Copying that shape into a customer app reproduces a defect the platform can already see and warn about.

⇒ That is facet ③ in its plainest form, and it points at **option 1** — wrap `send_reminder` in a `try_catch` whose `catch` is one bare `assignment`, the spelling `content/docs/automation/flows.mdx` documents under "Per-iteration containment". The example then demonstrates the loop container **and** the per-iteration guard, which is more teaching per line than it does today.

⛔ **Option 2 is not recommended and is ⛔ not foreclosed.** Keeping fail-fast deliberately and saying so in the flow's `description` is defensible — but it teaches the reader a shape the linter flags, so the description has to carry the whole justification, and a reader who copies the flow will not copy the description. The lane may still choose it; if so, say why in the PR rather than in the flow alone.

⛔ This is not sent to the decision inbox: it is an authoring choice inside one example app, on no manual floor, narrowing no ruling. The lane decides.

⚠️ Premise age: the reading is from 2026-09-02, taken while implementing #14394 (PR #14617). Re-verify on `origin/main` that `flow-loop-body-uncontained` still fires on this flow before editing — if PR #14617 has since moved, both the rule and the hit want re-deriving. ⛔ Locate the nodes by name, not by the line numbers here.

## 方向已定 —— 走 **option 1**，⛔ 不要自己重选

分诊 5542173349 荐 option 1 并把决定权交给车道（*"The lane decides"*）。⇒ **席内定：option 1**，理由采纳分诊那句：

> **the example apps are what AI authors copy from.**

一个 loop 在第一个 `owner` 为空的 task 上就终结整轮，而运行摘要对**确实发生过**的工作报 `acted: 0` —— 正是 #13681 实测的形状。把它抄进客户应用，就是复制一个平台自己已经能看见并告警的缺陷。

- ✅ **做这个**：把 `send_reminder` 包进 `try_catch`，其 `catch` 是**一个裸 `assignment` 节点** —— `content/docs/automation/flows.mdx` 的 "Per-iteration containment" 记录的那种拼写。example 于是同时演示 loop 容器**和**逐迭代守卫，每行教的东西比今天多。
- ⛔ **不做 option 2**（保留 fail-fast、在 `description` 里说明）：分诊说它可辩护但不荐 —— 它教给读者一个 linter 会标的形状，而**抄这个 flow 的人不会连 description 一起抄**。若你在实现中发现 option 1 有真障碍，⛔ 不要自己改判，**停下来报告**。

## ⚠️ 动手前必须先重验前置 —— 分诊明令

> Re-verify on `origin/main` that `flow-loop-body-uncontained` still fires on this flow before editing — if PR #14617 has since moved, both the rule and the hit want re-deriving. ⛔ Locate the nodes by name, not by the line numbers here.

PM 在当前 main 上按名字定位到（⚠️ 行号仅供你核对，**认名字不认行号**）：

```
:856  export const BatchRemindersFlow = defineFlow({
:867      id: 'loop_tasks'
:878          id: 'send_reminder'          ← 与 loop 之间没有 try_catch
```

（`:1009` / `:1226` 那两处 `try_catch` 属于**别的 flow**，⛔ 不要误读成本 flow 已经有守卫。）

⭐ **告警本身要实测出来**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/example-showcase build`，在输出里数 `flow-loop-body-uncontained` 的条数，改前应 ≥1 且**点名这个 flow**，改后应为 0。⛔ 光看 build exit 0 不算 —— 这条规则是 **warning 档**，破的树上 build 一样退 0（#16069 那一轮已经在这个仓上吃过这个亏：33 条告警下 build 照样绿）。⭐ 同时给一个**对照类**（例如 `react-prop-deprecated` 的条数）证明你数的是真直方图而不是空集。

## 边界

⛔ 不碰其它任何 flow，⛔ 不碰 `packages/services/service-automation/**`（#15230 本轮由另一座位在改 `engine.ts`），⛔ 不碰 `packages/lint/**`（规则本身是 #14394 / PR #14617 的）。
⚠️ 若 `examples/app-showcase/access-matrix.json` 出现漂移导致 build 报错，那说明你改到了权限面 —— **停下报告**，一个 flow 里加 `try_catch` 不应该动到授权快照。
⚠️ 若 dogfood 那套（`packages/qa/dogfood/`）转红，那是真实读数，报告，⛔ 不要靠调断言让它变绿。

## 交付纪律

⭐ 门族在最终 head 上 `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --commands` 机械推导并全跑；退出码紧接单条重定向之后捕获，⛔ 永不走管道；exit 3 `PREREQUISITE NOT MET` 要满足前置后重跑成真读数，⛔ 不得记作 pass。
⭐ changeset：判断并说理由 —— `@objectstack/example-showcase` 是 `"private": true`，⇒ 大概率 `skip-changeset`，但⛔ 不要默认，把 private 那一条读出来再说。
⛔ 不在 PR 正文预测 CI 状态。⛔ worktree-first，⛔ 永不 `git stash`。
